body.notice: No week on the record yet: the record starts the first week Sleeper's projections are archived before kickoff.

catalogue.label: Games played
catalogue.definition: Games he played in the window: a game counts when he had an offensive snap or a pass, carry, target or kick.
catalogue.aggregation: count of games played
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats + snap counts
catalogue.reason: no game in the window

catalogue.label: Fantasy points
catalogue.definition: Fantasy points in this league's scoring.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.source: this league's scoring over nflverse weekly player stats

catalogue.label: Expected fantasy points per game
catalogue.definition: What his targets and carries were worth on average (an opportunity-based estimate of past games, not next week's projection), in this league's scoring.
catalogue.denominator: games with an expected value
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no expected value for his games (a kicker, or games before the opportunity model)

catalogue.label: Targets
catalogue.definition: Passes thrown to him.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Target share
catalogue.definition: His targets / his team's targets in the games he played (a game he missed is not counted against him).
catalogue.denominator: team targets in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats (team totals: fct_team_game)
catalogue.reason: no team targets in his games

catalogue.label: Receptions
catalogue.definition: Catches.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Receiving yards
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Receiving touchdowns
catalogue.definition: Receiving touchdowns.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Catch rate
catalogue.definition: Receptions per target.
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Receiving yards per target
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards per target.
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Air-yard share
catalogue.definition: His receiving air yards / his team's passing air yards in the games he played. Signed: can be negative or pass 100% when the team's total is small.
catalogue.denominator: team passing air yards in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: his team's air yards in his games are zero

catalogue.label: Average depth of target
catalogue.definition: How far past the line of scrimmage his targets travel, on average (air yards per target).
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Yards after the catch per reception
catalogue.definition: Yards after the catch per reception.
catalogue.denominator: receptions
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no receptions

catalogue.label: Red-zone targets
catalogue.definition: Targets with the ball at the opponent's 20 or closer (penalty-nullified plays and two-point tries excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Red-zone target share
catalogue.definition: His red-zone targets / his team's red-zone targets in the games he played (targets only, not carries).
catalogue.denominator: team red-zone targets in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: no team red-zone targets in his games

catalogue.label: First-read target share
catalogue.definition: Of his team's charted targets thrown to the quarterback's first read, the share thrown to him — in the charted games he played. Built from charted targeted plays: it does not know every play's first-read assignment, only where the ball went when the first read was thrown to.
catalogue.numerator: his charted targets marked first read
catalogue.denominator: team charted first-read targets in the charted games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Catchable-target rate
catalogue.definition: Charted targets FTN marks catchable / his charted targets.
catalogue.denominator: charted targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Charted targets
catalogue.definition: His targets on plays FTN charted (the sample behind first-read share and catchable rate).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Route participation (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Dropbacks he was on the field for (a receiver, back or tight end) / his team's dropbacks with participation, in the games he played. An estimate: being on the field for a dropback is not a route run (runs ~10–15% low).
catalogue.denominator: team dropbacks with participation in his games
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Targets per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Targets / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.denominator: dropbacks on the field
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Yards per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.numerator: receiving yards in games with participation
catalogue.denominator: dropbacks on the field
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Average separation (yards)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' average distance, in yards, between him and the nearest defender when the pass arrives (a catch or an incompletion), per target. A context number, not a talent score. NGS publishes a week only for a receiver or tight end with 5+ targets; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's targets — never a mean of means.
catalogue.denominator: NGS targets in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (5+ targets, receivers and tight ends only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Yards after the catch over expected per reception
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' yards after the catch minus what its tracking model expected at the catch, per reception. NGS publishes a week only for a receiver or tight end with 5+ targets; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's receptions — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly YAC over expected x NGS receptions
catalogue.denominator: NGS receptions in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (5+ targets, receivers and tight ends only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Routes run
catalogue.definition: Routes run from a licensed charting feed. None is connected (FTN and PFF sell one; see docs/DATA_INVENTORY.md).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.reason: No licensed routes feed is connected; nflverse participation is published after the season.

catalogue.label: Carries
catalogue.definition: Rush attempts (nflverse carries: scrambles and kneel-downs included, two-point tries excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Carry share
catalogue.definition: His carries / his team's carries in the games he played. The team's carries include quarterback scrambles and kneel-downs (nflverse carries); two-point tries are excluded. The card's Carry share is this number.
catalogue.denominator: team carries in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats (team totals: fct_team_game)
catalogue.reason: no team carries in his games

catalogue.label: Backfield carry share (RBs only)
catalogue.definition: His carries / the carries of his team's running backs and fullbacks in the games he played — quarterback runs and kneel-downs and receivers' carries left out. Kept apart from Carry share.
catalogue.denominator: team RB + FB carries in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: no running-back carries for his team in his games

catalogue.label: Rushing yards
catalogue.definition: Rushing yards.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Rushing touchdowns
catalogue.definition: Rushing touchdowns.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Rushing yards per carry
catalogue.definition: Rushing yards per carry.
catalogue.denominator: carries
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no carries

catalogue.label: Red-zone carries
catalogue.definition: Carries with the ball at the opponent's 20 or closer.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Red-zone carry share
catalogue.definition: His red-zone carries / his team's red-zone carries in the games he played (carries only, not targets).
catalogue.denominator: team red-zone carries in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: no team red-zone carries in his games

catalogue.label: Carries inside the 5
catalogue.definition: Carries with the ball at the opponent's 5 or closer.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Inside-the-5 carry share
catalogue.definition: His carries inside the 5 / every carry inside the 5 by his team in the games he played.
catalogue.denominator: team carries inside the 5 in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: his team had no carries inside the 5 in his games

catalogue.label: Red-zone opportunities
catalogue.definition: Red-zone carries + red-zone targets (a count; no combined percentage).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Rushing yards over expected per carry
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' rushing yards over expected per carry: his yards minus what NGS's tracking model expected from the blockers and defenders around him at the handoff. A context number, not a talent score. NGS publishes a week only for a running back with 10+ carries (from 2018); over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's carries — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly RYOE per carry x NGS carries
catalogue.denominator: NGS carries in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (10+ carries, running backs only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Pass attempts
catalogue.definition: Pass attempts (spikes included, sacks excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Completions
catalogue.definition: Completed passes.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Completion percentage
catalogue.definition: Completions per pass attempt.
catalogue.denominator: pass attempts
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no pass attempts

catalogue.label: Passing yards
catalogue.definition: Passing yards.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Passing yards per attempt
catalogue.definition: Passing yards per attempt.
catalogue.denominator: pass attempts
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no pass attempts

catalogue.label: Passing touchdowns
catalogue.definition: Passing touchdowns.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Interceptions
catalogue.definition: Interceptions thrown.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Sacks taken
catalogue.definition: Times sacked.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Dropbacks
catalogue.definition: Pass attempts + sacks + scrambles (spikes excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Scrambles
catalogue.definition: Dropbacks he turned into a run (nflfastR's scramble flag). Designed runs are not split out yet.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Completion % over expected (play-by-play)
catalogue.definition: nflfastR's completion percentage over expected, in points of percentage. Aggregated as the mean of his per-game CPOE weighted by pass attempts (nflverse publishes the per-game mean, not the per-throw sum): close to the per-throw mean, not identical. Not Next Gen Stats' CPOE.
catalogue.denominator: pass attempts
catalogue.aggregation: attempt-weighted mean of per-game CPOE
catalogue.reason: no pass attempts with a CPOE

catalogue.label: Time to throw (seconds)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' average time from the snap to his throw, in seconds. NGS publishes a week only when he has 15+ pass attempts; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's pass attempts — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly time to throw x NGS pass attempts
catalogue.denominator: NGS pass attempts in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (15+ pass attempts), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Completion % over expected (Next Gen Stats)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' completion percentage over expected, in points of percentage: NGS's tracking model sets each throw's expected completion (separation, depth, pressure). Not the play-by-play CPOE beside it. NGS publishes a week only when he has 15+ pass attempts; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's pass attempts — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly CPOE x NGS pass attempts
catalogue.denominator: NGS pass attempts in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (15+ pass attempts), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Pressure splits
catalogue.definition: Results under pressure. Needs a licensed charting feed (PFF / FTN pressure); not available.
catalogue.reason: Pressure charting is licensed data; none is connected.

catalogue.label: Snap share
catalogue.definition: His share of his team's offensive snaps. nflverse publishes each game's share (rounded to the percent), not the team's snap total, so several games are the mean of his per-game shares over games with snap counts (each game weighted equally) — the card's Snap share.
catalogue.denominator: games with snap counts
catalogue.aggregation: mean of per-game snap share over games with snap counts
catalogue.reason: no snap counts recorded for his games

body.howto:
- **One row per player over the window you pick**: the season, his last 3 or 5 *games played*, the last 3 or 5 *calendar weeks* (a bye or a missed game leaves fewer games: **G** says how many), or a week range.
- **Per game** divides the window's total by the games he played in it; shares and rates keep their own denominators (target share = his targets / his team's targets in the games he played).
- A share over several games is the summed numerator over the summed denominator, never an average of weekly percentages.
- A dash means the number cannot be worked out here (no targets, a season without charting, routes in season); hover it for the reason. Never zero.

body.howto:
- **Use it to spot a role change before the points show up**: add the risers off waivers, and think about moving the fallers.
- Each player's last **3 games** are compared with his games before that. A number is called **up** or **down** only when the change is big enough to matter (say, 3 points of target share) *and* bigger than his normal week-to-week swing.
- **Strength** says how unusual the change is for him: 1 is worth a look, 2 is a clear change. **Momentum** averages that over his work (targets, snaps, carries, how far downfield he is targeted, expected points) and ignores his fantasy points on purpose: three touchdowns can happen without the role changing at all.
- **Trend** names what moved: "↑ targets, ↑ snaps" is more work; "↑ targets, ↑ aDOT" (targeted deeper downfield) is a different, deeper role.
- Nothing is called a trend before a player's fourth game; until then the page shows an *early read* and says so.
- **Over / under**: points per game in this league's scoring against expected points per game (what his targets and carries are usually worth). Above = running hot, below = due.

howto_sections.title: How to read role alerts
howto_sections.text:
- **Act on a bigger role before the points show up**: a free agent here is a stash (Waiver Wire values him for your lineup); one of your bench players here may be worth a start. A smaller role is a reason to bench or sell.
- An alert means his share of the snaps, the targets or the carries jumped (or fell) in his last one to three games, well past his usual week-to-week swing, and held in every one of those games. A single big game is not an alert: three touchdowns can happen without the role changing.
- **Why** is the reason we can name: an injured starter (he is filling in), a benching or a depth-chart move, a trade. "The coaches changed his role" means none of those: fine, but check the news.
- **Held**: one game is a first look, three games is his role now. A fill-in's role ends when the starter returns: the card says so once the starter is off the injury report.
- How often they last: in the 2025 season, 67% of the bigger roles and 64% of the smaller ones were still there three games later (a fill-in counted only while the starter stayed out).

body.scoring_note: Fields ending in `_ref` are in the reference league's scoring (League of Scrubs), one scale for every league and season; the same field without `_ref` is this league's scoring.

catalogue.label: Games played
catalogue.definition: Games he played in the window: a game counts when he had an offensive snap or a pass, carry, target or kick.
catalogue.aggregation: count of games played
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats + snap counts
catalogue.reason: no game in the window

catalogue.label: Fantasy points
catalogue.definition: Fantasy points in this league's scoring.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.source: this league's scoring over nflverse weekly player stats

catalogue.label: Expected fantasy points per game
catalogue.definition: What his targets and carries were worth on average (an opportunity-based estimate of past games, not next week's projection), in this league's scoring.
catalogue.denominator: games with an expected value
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no expected value for his games (a kicker, or games before the opportunity model)

catalogue.label: Targets
catalogue.definition: Passes thrown to him.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Target share
catalogue.definition: His targets / his team's targets in the games he played (a game he missed is not counted against him).
catalogue.denominator: team targets in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats (team totals: fct_team_game)
catalogue.reason: no team targets in his games

catalogue.label: Receptions
catalogue.definition: Catches.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Receiving yards
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Receiving touchdowns
catalogue.definition: Receiving touchdowns.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Catch rate
catalogue.definition: Receptions per target.
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Receiving yards per target
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards per target.
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Air-yard share
catalogue.definition: His receiving air yards / his team's passing air yards in the games he played. Signed: can be negative or pass 100% when the team's total is small.
catalogue.denominator: team passing air yards in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: his team's air yards in his games are zero

catalogue.label: Average depth of target
catalogue.definition: How far past the line of scrimmage his targets travel, on average (air yards per target).
catalogue.denominator: targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no targets

catalogue.label: Yards after the catch per reception
catalogue.definition: Yards after the catch per reception.
catalogue.denominator: receptions
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: no receptions

catalogue.label: Red-zone targets
catalogue.definition: Targets with the ball at the opponent's 20 or closer (penalty-nullified plays and two-point tries excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Red-zone target share
catalogue.definition: His red-zone targets / his team's red-zone targets in the games he played (targets only, not carries).
catalogue.denominator: team red-zone targets in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: no team red-zone targets in his games

catalogue.label: First-read target share
catalogue.definition: Of his team's charted targets thrown to the quarterback's first read, the share thrown to him — in the charted games he played. Built from charted targeted plays: it does not know every play's first-read assignment, only where the ball went when the first read was thrown to.
catalogue.numerator: his charted targets marked first read
catalogue.denominator: team charted first-read targets in the charted games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Catchable-target rate
catalogue.definition: Charted targets FTN marks catchable / his charted targets.
catalogue.denominator: charted targets
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Charted targets
catalogue.definition: His targets on plays FTN charted (the sample behind first-read share and catchable rate).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.reason: FTN charting starts in 2022 and covers only the games charted so far this season.

catalogue.label: Route participation (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Dropbacks he was on the field for (a receiver, back or tight end) / his team's dropbacks with participation, in the games he played. An estimate: being on the field for a dropback is not a route run (runs ~10–15% low).
catalogue.denominator: team dropbacks with participation in his games
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Targets per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Targets / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.denominator: dropbacks on the field
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Yards per route run (estimate)
catalogue.definition: Receiving yards / dropbacks he was on the field for, in games with participation.
catalogue.numerator: receiving yards in games with participation
catalogue.denominator: dropbacks on the field
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the window
catalogue.reason: Routes: nflverse publishes participation after the season (2025 is the last season with it), so this season is blank until then; no licensed routes feed is connected.

catalogue.label: Average separation (yards)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' average distance, in yards, between him and the nearest defender when the pass arrives (a catch or an incompletion), per target. A context number, not a talent score. NGS publishes a week only for a receiver or tight end with 5+ targets; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's targets — never a mean of means.
catalogue.denominator: NGS targets in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (5+ targets, receivers and tight ends only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Yards after the catch over expected per reception
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' yards after the catch minus what its tracking model expected at the catch, per reception. NGS publishes a week only for a receiver or tight end with 5+ targets; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's receptions — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly YAC over expected x NGS receptions
catalogue.denominator: NGS receptions in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (5+ targets, receivers and tight ends only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Routes run
catalogue.definition: Routes run from a licensed charting feed. None is connected (FTN and PFF sell one; see docs/DATA_INVENTORY.md).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window
catalogue.reason: No licensed routes feed is connected; nflverse participation is published after the season.

catalogue.label: Carries
catalogue.definition: Rush attempts (nflverse carries: scrambles and kneel-downs included, two-point tries excluded).
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.label: Carry share
catalogue.definition: His carries / his team's carries in the games he played. The team's carries include quarterback scrambles and kneel-downs (nflverse carries); two-point tries are excluded. The card's Carry share is this number.
catalogue.denominator: team carries in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.source: nflverse weekly player stats (team totals: fct_team_game)
catalogue.reason: no team carries in his games

catalogue.label: Backfield carry share (RBs only)
catalogue.definition: His carries / the carries of his team's running backs and fullbacks in the games he played — quarterback runs and kneel-downs and receivers' carries left out. Kept apart from Carry share.
catalogue.denominator: team RB + FB carries in the games he played
catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)
catalogue.reason: no running-back carries for his team in his games

catalogue.definition: Rushing yards.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.definition: Rushing touchdowns.
catalogue.aggregation: summed over his game rows in the window

catalogue.aggregation: summed numerator / summed denominator over the games he played in the window (never a mean of weekly %)

catalogue.label: Inside-the-5 carry share
catalogue.definition: His carries inside the 5 / every carry inside the 5 by his team in the games he played.
catalogue.denominator: team carries inside the 5 in the games he played

catalogue.label: Red-zone opportunities

catalogue.label: Rushing yards over expected per carry
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' rushing yards over expected per carry: his yards minus what NGS's tracking model expected from the blockers and defenders around him at the handoff. A context number, not a talent score. NGS publishes a week only for a running back with 10+ carries (from 2018); over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's carries — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly RYOE per carry x NGS carries
catalogue.denominator: NGS carries in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (10+ carries, running backs only), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Completion % over expected (play-by-play)
catalogue.definition: nflfastR's completion percentage over expected, in points of percentage. Aggregated as the mean of his per-game CPOE weighted by pass attempts (nflverse publishes the per-game mean, not the per-throw sum): close to the per-throw mean, not identical. Not Next Gen Stats' CPOE.
catalogue.denominator: pass attempts

catalogue.reason: no pass attempts with a CPOE

catalogue.label: Time to throw (seconds)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' average time from the snap to his throw, in seconds. NGS publishes a week only when he has 15+ pass attempts; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's pass attempts — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly time to throw x NGS pass attempts
catalogue.denominator: NGS pass attempts in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (15+ pass attempts), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Completion % over expected (Next Gen Stats)
catalogue.definition: NFL Next Gen Stats' completion percentage over expected, in points of percentage: NGS's tracking model sets each throw's expected completion (separation, depth, pressure). Not the play-by-play CPOE beside it. NGS publishes a week only when he has 15+ pass attempts; over several weeks it is the mean of his weekly values weighted by NGS's pass attempts — never a mean of means.
catalogue.numerator: weekly CPOE x NGS pass attempts
catalogue.denominator: NGS pass attempts in his qualifying weeks
catalogue.aggregation: mean of NGS's weekly values weighted by the denominator NGS states, over his weeks in the window that NGS published (never a mean of means)
catalogue.source: NFL Next Gen Stats via nflverse (mart_player_ngs_week)
catalogue.reason: No Next Gen Stats week in this window: NGS publishes a week only when he clears its minimum (15+ pass attempts), so this is unknown, not zero.

catalogue.label: Pressure splits
catalogue.definition: Results under pressure. Needs a licensed charting feed (PFF / FTN pressure); not available.
catalogue.reason: Pressure charting is licensed data; none is connected.

catalogue.label: Snap share
catalogue.definition: His share of his team's offensive snaps. nflverse publishes each game's share (rounded to the percent), not the team's snap total, so several games are the mean of his per-game shares over games with snap counts (each game weighted equally) — the card's Snap share.
catalogue.denominator: games with snap counts
catalogue.aggregation: mean of per-game snap share over games with snap counts
catalogue.reason: no snap counts recorded for his games

body.howto:
- **One row per player over the window you pick**: the season, his last 3 or 5 *games played*, the last 3 or 5 *calendar weeks* (a bye or a missed game leaves fewer games: **G** says how many), or a week range.
- **Per game** divides the window's total by the games he played in it; shares and rates keep their own denominators (target share = his targets / his team's targets in the games he played).
- A share over several games is the summed numerator over the summed denominator, never an average of weekly percentages.
- A dash means the number cannot be worked out here (no targets, a season without charting, routes in season); hover it for the reason. Never zero.
